title: Bandar Abbas calm wind -> STNG
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Bandar Abbas 5d mean max wind below 20th percentile (calm seas favour small-boat attacks) leads STNG log returns by 2 days (+); trade long STNG 5d [weather.bandar_abbas.wind_max -> finance.STNG.log_return]
message: Not supported: Bandar Abbas wind_max vs STNG log returns r=0.006 (n=387), best lag -1d r=-0.05; rule 53 trades hit 58% but excess -0.10%/trade, OOS 19 trades avg +0.02%; actionability 2.68 (story, not rule)

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.bandar_abbas.wind_max rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long STNG next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Bandar Abbas max wind 20d z-score > 1 (rough seas suppress small-boat harassment, easing tanker risk premium) leads STNG log returns by 3 days (-); trade short STNG 3d [weather.bandar_abbas.wind_max -> finance.STNG.log_return] (parent: R2-0010)
